name: Grappler
description: You’ve developed the skills necessary to hold your own in close-quarters grappling. You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature you are grappling, and you can use your action to try to pin a creature grappled by you.

activatedAbilities.name: Pin Grappled Creature
activatedAbilities.description: You can use your action to try to pin a creature grappled by you. To do so, make another grapple check. If you succeed, you and the creature are both restrained until the grapple ends.
